job.title: Full-Stack Unity Developer – Interactive Games & Real-Time System @ ThingTrax (HR, IN)
job.description:
Full-Stack Unity Developer – Interactive Games & Real-Time Systems

**Company:** Moptiq  
**Location:** Faridabad, Delhi NCR  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, on-site  
**Experience:** 3+ years preferred

About Moptiq

Moptiq is building a new generation of physical-digital gaming experiences designed to get people moving and playing together.

Our platform combines Unity games, high-speed computer vision, motion tracking and large-format projection. Players use real footballs, bows, Nerf blasters and body movement to interact with digital game environments.

We are looking for a hands-on Full-Stack Unity Developer who can take ownership of complete games—from gameplay and animations to tracking integration, operator interfaces, leaderboards and deployment at physical venues.

What You Will Do

* Design and develop engaging 2D and 3D games in Unity.
* Turn game concepts into playable prototypes quickly and improve them through physical playtesting.
* Build gameplay involving footballs, projectiles, player movement and other real-world interactions.
* Develop game mechanics, physics, animations, UI, audio, VFX, scoring and difficulty progression.
* Integrate Unity with our computer-vision and motion-tracking systems through UDP, TCP, WebSockets or REST APIs.
* Handle coordinate conversion, calibration data, tracking confidence, latency and temporary loss of tracking.
* Build or integrate operator interfaces for player registration, game selection and session management.
* Develop backend services for player profiles, scores, sessions, challenges and leaderboards.
* Connect games to databases and web-based APIs.
* Build local multiplayer and team-based game modes.
* Optimize games for stable real-time performance on Windows PCs and large projected displays.
* Integrate projectors, cameras, sound systems, sensors and other venue hardware.
* Create reliable builds, configuration tools, logs and automatic recovery mechanisms for venue operation.
* Test games in our physical setup and troubleshoot software and hardware integration issues.
* Work closely with the founders, vision engineers, 3D artists and game designers.

Required Skills

* Strong practical experience with Unity and C#.
* Solid understanding of Unity physics, animation, prefabs, UI, particle systems and scene management.
* Experience developing complete games or interactive applications.
* Experience integrating Unity with external APIs or real-time data sources.
* Knowledge of UDP/TCP communication, REST APIs, JSON and WebSockets.
* Backend development experience using Python, Node.js, C#/.NET or a similar technology.
* Familiarity with SQL or cloud databases.
* Strong debugging, profiling and performance-optimization skills.
* Experience using Git and maintaining clean, modular code.
* Ability to work independently and take responsibility for complete features.
* Willingness to work full-time from our Faridabad office, as regular testing with physical equipment is essential.

Good to Have

* Experience with motion capture, computer vision, Kinect, RealSense or other tracking systems.
* Experience with projection mapping, multi-display installations or location-based entertainment.
* Understanding of coordinate systems, camera calibration and 3D transformations.
* Experience developing arcade, sports, multiplayer or party games.
* Shader Graph, VFX Graph or custom shader experience.
* Experience with Android-based HMI or companion applications.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for creating, texturing, rigging or animating 3D assets.
* Experience deploying and remotely supporting games at customer locations.

Who We Are Looking For

You should enjoy building things that combine software with the physical world. This position is suited to someone who can move from an idea to a working prototype, test it with actual players and continue improving it until it becomes a reliable commercial game.

A strong portfolio and evidence of what you have personally built will matter more than formal qualifications alone.

What Moptiq Offers

* Ownership of complete games and major product features.
* Opportunity to build a new physical gaming platform from the ground up.
* Work across gaming, computer vision, motion tracking and immersive technology.
* Direct involvement in product and gameplay decisions.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and portfolio.
* Opportunity to grow into a Lead Unity Developer or Technical Lead role.

How to Apply

Please apply with:

* Your CV
* Unity portfolio, GitHub profile or gameplay videos
* A short explanation of what you personally developed in each project
* Current and expected compensation
* Notice period
* Confirmation that you can work full-time from Faridabad

Pay: ₹380,887.68 - ₹1,636,120.95 per year

Work Location: In person

job.title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) - Consumer Intelligence & Engagement @ PUMA (MH, IN)
job.description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.

  

**Your mission**
----------------

You will be part of the Consumer Intelligence & Engagement organisation responsible for delivering the intelligence and engagement capabilities that enable more relevant and personalised consumer experiences across digital channels. The organisation plays a key role in how consumers discover products, engage with content, and elevate experiences through membership & loyalty. Through capabilities such as personalisation, recommendations, consumer intelligence, experimentation, and AI-driven decisioning, the organisation helps deliver more contextual, data-driven interactions across the consumer journey.

As a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack), you will design, build, and maintain production-grade backend services and web applications that power personalisation and recommendation capabilities. You will work closely with Tech Leads, AI/ML Engineers, Product Owners, and Data Engineering teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and low-latency services.

**What you will do:**

* Develop production-grade APIs and service layers that expose personalisation and recommendations to consuming applications and digital experience layers.
* Build and evolve web-based applications and user experiences.
* Build model-serving and inference integration layers that support real-time and batch recommendation patterns.
* Implement reliable, scalable, and low-latency services with strong focus on resiliency, observability, and performance.
* Work with caching, event-driven processing and distributed systems patterns to support high-volume consumer use cases.
* Collaborate with Tech Leads, AI/ML Engineers, Data Engineering and Product teams to deliver roadmap commitments.
* Drive technical design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions within the team.
* Ensure applications and services are production-ready through effective observability, monitoring, performance optimisation, reliability engineering, and operational readiness practices.
* Mentor junior engineers, perform code reviews and help establish engineering standards and best practices.
* Utilise AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate development and strengthen code quality.

**Your talent**
---------------

* 7+ years of experience designing and building scalable, resilient, and maintainable microservices and web applications in modern cloud environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot for building production backend services.
* Frontend development experience with React framework strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of system design and distributed architecture.
* Solid understanding of distributed systems fundamentals including concurrency, asynchronous processing, idempotency, exception handling and circuit breakers.
* Strong data structures and algorithms foundation with experience applying them to real-world use cases.
* Experience with event-driven architecture using Kafka or similar technologies.
* Experience with SQL/No-SQL databases with understanding of database architecture and distributed data management.
* Experience integrating LLM APIs into production applications will be a strong advantage.
* Understanding of embedding-based similarity search and vector databases is an advantage.
* Strong ability to mentor engineers, review designs, and drive sound technical decisions.
* Experience using coding agents, LLMs or AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and developer productivity.
* Experience in eCommerce, retail, or consumer digital products is preferred.

**Our principles**
------------------

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.

At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.

PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

job.title: Director of Engineering Consumer Experience - Web & Mobile @ PUMA (MH, IN)
job.description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.

  

**Your mission**
----------------

As Director of Engineering - Consumer Experience, you'll lead the technology organisation responsible for delivering exceptional digital experiences across Web and Mobile platforms. This is a horizontal, platform-level leadership role that sets the engineering direction, standards, and quality bar across every consumer-facing product in our Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) business.

You'll own the engineering foundation that product teams build upon - shared platform capabilities, AI-native tooling, frontend standards, and delivery infrastructure - and lead a lean team of senior engineers and a network of delivery partners to build fast, accessible, AI-native experiences that delight our consumers. You'll hold platform adoption authority and co-own the engineering quality bar across the organisation.

As PUMA continues to scale its DTC Engineering organization, our leaders are expected to be visible culture builders. These roles are office-based and require regular in-person collaboration to accelerate decision-making, strengthen team cohesion, foster innovation, and build a world-class engineering capability from the ground up.

**Key Responsibilities & Scope of Ownership:**

**Technology Vision & Strategy**

* Define and drive the multi-year Consumer Experience technology vision, ensuring alignment with DTC business goals and emerging digital trends.
* Build and communicate a clear technology roadmap covering Web (desktop, PWA) and Native Mobile (iOS, Android) platforms.
* Champion AI-native engineering paradigm - from AI-assisted development workflows to front-end personalisation and intelligent UX embedded into the engineering culture from day one.
* Evaluate, select, and govern the technology stack (ReactJS, GraphQL, and emerging tools) to ensure longevity, performance, and developer productivity.

**Standards, Governance & Engineering Excellence**

* Establish and enforce engineering standards, coding practices, design systems, accessibility guidelines (WCAG), and performance benchmarks across all consumer-facing touchpoints.
* Build and own a component library and design system that enables velocity and consistency for all product teams.
* Define governance frameworks for third-party vendor engagement including contracts, code quality reviews, delivery cadence, and SLA management.
* Introduce and maintain observability, performance monitoring, and incident management practices for consumer-facing platforms.

**UI/UX & Consumer Experience Leadership**

* Partner closely with UX/Design, Product, and Marketing teams to translate consumer insights into technically excellent digital experiences.
* Own the front-end architecture for responsive, performant, and accessible web experiences and mobile applications.
* Drive adoption of modern UX engineering practices such as skeleton screens, optimistic UI, progressive enhancement, micro-interactions.
* Champion performance engineering - page load, rendering optimisation, image delivery, CDN strategy, and headless CMS integration via Sanity.

**Team & Vendor Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a lean team of senior engineers while maintaining a high-trust, high-performance culture.
* Manage and hold accountable delivery partners for quality, timelines, and engineering standards.
* Partner with Engineering Heads, Product Owners and peer Directors to ensure horizontal services (design systems, shared APIs, performance tooling) are adopted consistently.

**Your talent**
---------------

**Key Requirements:**

* 15+ years of progressive engineering experience, with 5+ years in a senior engineering leadership role.
* Strong architectural and implementation experience in modern front-end engineering: ReactJS, TypeScript, GraphQL (GQL), REST APIs.
* Demonstrable mobile architecture & engineering experience across React Native or iOS (Swift)/Android (Kotlin).
* Track record of building and governing cross-functional engineering platforms used by multiple product teams.
* Strong working knowledge of modern consumer web standards, specifically web performance (Core Web Vitals), WCAG 2.1 compliance, and progressive web applications.
* Background in fashion, retail, or sports DTC commerce environments.
* Experience with composable/headless commerce architectures.
* Experience with CI/CD, feature flagging, A/B testing frameworks.
* Experience with Design Systems & Shared UI Platforms is highly preferred.
* Experience in SFCC (Salesforce Commerce Cloud) storefront or equivalent will be a plus.
* Demonstrated adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity, software quality and efficiency.

**Leadership Expectations:**

* At PUMA, Directors are expected to operate as enterprise leaders who shape strategy, build capability, and create an environment where teams can deliver exceptional outcomes at speed and scale. Successful leaders combine commercial acumen, technical excellence, and people leadership while embodying the mindset and behaviours that define PUMA's culture.

**Strategic Thinking & Vision**

* Translate ambitious business goals into clear, executable technology strategies and roadmaps.
* Demonstrate the courage to challenge conventional thinking and advocate for innovative solutions that create long-term value.
* Operate effectively in ambiguity, providing clarity, direction, and confidence for teams and stakeholders.
* Balance immediate business priorities with long-term scalability, sustainability, and consumer impact.
* **Ownership & Accountability**
* Take end-to-end ownership of outcomes, driving execution with determination and a strong focus on results.
* Set high standards for quality, reliability, and operational excellence while fostering a culture of accountability.
* Navigate setbacks and changing priorities with resilience, maintaining momentum through complexity and uncertainty.
* Make difficult decisions when required and stand behind them with conviction and integrity.

**People & Team Leadership**

* Build, develop, and retain diverse, high-performing teams capable of delivering at scale.
* Foster an environment of trust, inclusion, collaboration, and mutual respect where individuals can thrive.
* Create opportunities for learning, growth, and continuous development while empowering teams with autonomy and accountability.
* Celebrate successes, recognise contributions, and cultivate a culture where high performance and enjoyment go hand in hand.

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong partnerships across Product, Design, Data, Marketing, Operations, and Business teams to achieve shared outcomes.
* Influence effectively across all levels of the organisation through credibility, transparency, and strong communication.
* Demonstrate confidence in decision-making while remaining open to challenge, feedback, and diverse perspectives.
* Lead with a team-first mindset, breaking down silos and enabling collaboration across functions and geographies.

**Innovation & Continuous Learning**

* Champion modern engineering practices, AI-native ways of working, and a culture of experimentation.
* Encourage curiosity, learning, and thoughtful risk-taking to unlock new opportunities for consumers and the business.
* Create space for innovation while maintaining a disciplined approach to execution and delivery.
* Continuously raise the bar on engineering excellence, operational maturity, and consumer experience.

**Commercial & Consumer Mindset**

* Understand the connection between technology decisions, consumer experience, and business performance.
* Make decisions that balance innovation, speed, quality, and commercial impact.
* Maintain a strong consumer-first perspective, ensuring technology investments create meaningful value for consumers.
* Demonstrate sound judgment and confidence when translating business priorities into engineering outcomes.

**Building PUMA's Future**

* Act as a visible culture builder and role model as PUMA continues to scale its DTC Engineering organisation.
* Embrace the opportunity to build teams, capabilities, and ways of working from the ground up.
* Lead with energy, optimism, and purpose, inspiring others to contribute to a shared vision and ambitious goals.
* Foster an environment where bold thinking, determination, collaboration, and enjoyment are all essential ingredients of success.

**Our principles**
------------------

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.

At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.

PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

job.title: DST Business Analyst and Business Intelligence Developer - Husky (Guindy,Chennai) @ Husky Injection Molding (TN, IN)
job.description:
At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

  

**Job Description**

The DST Business Analyst and Business Intelligence Developer for Husky will be responsible for designing, delivering, and maintaining the company’s enterprise business intelligence ecosystem, leveraging both internal and external data sources. This role will lead the development and support of enterprise-wide BI applications, data models, and analytics architecture. Working closely with senior business and IT stakeholders, the position will translate strategic data and information requirements into actionable solutions that enable data-driven decision making.

The incumbent will address complex technical challenges, optimize performance across BI platforms, and define data elements that drive meaningful insights and measurable business value. The role will also establish testing standards, develop and deliver training programs to enhance user adoption, and promote self‑service analytics. Additionally, this position will define governance standards, policies, and procedures for BI tools and data structures, establish data quality metrics, and evaluate emerging technologies to support continuous improvement of Husky’s enterprise BI capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities & Key Success Metrics**

* Leading BI software development, deployment and maintenance
* Perform Data Profiling and Data Analysis activities to understand data sources
* Report curation, template definition and analytical data modeling
* Work with cross-functional teams to gather and document reporting requirements
* Translate business requirements into specifications that will be used to implement the required reports and dashboards, created from potentially multiple data sources
* Identifies and resolves data reporting issues in a timely fashion, while looking for continuous improvement opportunities.
* Build solutions that create value and resolve business problems
* Provide technical guidance to designers and other stakeholders
* Work effectively with members of Digital Solutions Team
* Troubleshoots analytics tool problems and tunes for performance
* Develops semantic layer and analytics query objects for end users
* Translation of business questions and requirements into reports, views, and analytics query objects
* Ensuring that quality standards are met
* Supporting Master Data Management Strategy

**Qualifications:**

**Technical Skills & Experience**

* Strong understanding of ERP and operational system data structures, with the ability to interpret, navigate, and optimize complex relational databases.
* Advanced proficiency in writing high‑performance SQL queries against large‑scale, complex datasets, including optimization and troubleshooting.
* Hands‑on experience in data visualization, dashboard design, and data storytelling, with the ability to translate analytical insights into clear, compelling, and actionable narratives.
* Experience designing, debugging, and deploying BI solutions within an Azure DevOps (ADO) environment, including CI/CD practices, version control, and release management.
* Proficiency with the Microsoft BI Stack, including:

* Power BI (data modeling, DAX, visualization best practices, Power BI Service)
* SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS/AAS)—tabular model development, optimization, and deployment

Experience working with Azure Data Platform services such as Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse Analytics, and Power BI Service.

Knowledge of Databricks or Microsoft Fabric is considered a strong asset.

**Business & Functional Knowledge**

* Basic understanding of manufacturing and sales business processes, with the ability to translate operational requirements into analytical solutions.
* Experience working in an international or distributed business environment, collaborating across regions and time zones.

**Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills**

* Strong analytical capabilities, with the ability to interpret requirements, profile data, validate output, and ensure accuracy across BI solutions.
* Adept at diagnosing data inconsistencies, performance issues, and modeling challenges, proposing effective, scalable solutions.

**Communication & Collaboration**

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of conveying technical concepts to business stakeholders in clear, understandable terms.
* Ability to facilitate meetings, workshops, and design sessions, enabling effective collaboration and informed decision-making.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams, including Data Engineering, Business Analysts, and business partners.

**Language Requirements**

* Proficiency in English is required.
* Knowledge of German or French is considered an asset.

  

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.
